Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 15

“Knowing this, the ancient seekers of liberation also performed action. Therefore do the very work that was done by those of old in earlier times.”

Krishna returns to lineage, this time as reassurance. The people who most wanted release still worked, so Arjuna's longing to withdraw has no precedent among them.
